title: SMENet: Multi-scale Feature Enhancement Detection Network for Infrared Small Targets
affiliations: Communication University of China, Communication University of China, Communication University of China, Guangxi Normal University and Nipissing University

detail.title: SMENet: Multi-scale Feature Enhancement Detection Network for Infrared Small Targets
detail.abstract: Infrared small target detection is essential for long-range surveillance, aerial reconnaissance, maritime monitoring, and early-warning systems. However, it remains challenging because targets usually occupy only a few pixels and are easily submerged by sensor noise and cluttered backgrounds. Existing detectors often improve only a single aspect of feature extraction, while the coordinated enhancement of contextual perception, directional representation, and shallow-detail preservation remains insufficient. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Multi-scale Feature Enhancement Detection Network (SMENet) for infrared small target detection. Specifically, a Multi-Receptive Field Attention (MRFA) module is introduced to capture richer multi-scale contextual information through adaptive receptive field expansion. In addition, a Spiral Convolution (SConv) module enhances directional sensitivity via asymmetric direction-aware feature extraction, improving the discrimination of weak target boundaries against background interference. Furthermore, a Reconstructive Small Object Head (ReSOHead) reorganizes the detection hierarchy and feature fusion pathway to strengthen high-resolution shallow-detail propagation for small-target representation. Extensive experiments on the public IRSTD-1k dataset and the self-built IRdata-4465 dataset demonstrate that SMENet consistently achieves superior detection accuracy and recall compared with competitive baselines, while maintaining favorable computational efficiency and real-time inference capability. The results verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework in challenging infrared small target detection scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多尺度特征增强检测网络（SMENet），通过多感受野注意力、螺旋卷积和重构小目标头部三个模块，协同提升红外小目标检测的性能，在公开和自建数据集上均取得了优异效果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够协同增强上下文感知、方向性表示和浅层细节保留的红外小目标检测网络？
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测器通常只改进特征提取的单一维度，缺乏对多尺度上下文信息、方向敏感性和高分辨率浅层细节的协同增强，导致弱小目标检测效果不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度特征增强理论、注意力机制、方向感知卷积、特征金字塔重构
AI.method: 提出了SMENet，包含三个核心模块：1) 多感受野注意力模块（MRFA）——通过自适应感受野扩展捕获多尺度上下文信息；2) 螺旋卷积模块（SConv）——通过非对称方向感知特征提取增强方向敏感性；3) 重构小目标头部（ReSOHead）——重组检测层次和特征融合路径，增强浅层细节传播。
AI.findings: 在IRSTD-1k和自建IRdata-4465数据集上，SMENet相比基线模型取得了更优的检测精度和召回率，同时保持了良好的计算效率和实时推理能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了多感受野注意力机制，实现自适应感受野扩展；2) 设计了螺旋卷积，增强了方向敏感性特征提取；3) 提出了重构检测头结构，优化了小目标的浅层细节传播路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为红外小目标检测提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案，适用于远程监视、空中侦察、海上监测和预警系统等实际场景。

title: ACO-TGFuse: Ant Colony Optimization-Guided Transformer Fusion for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
affiliations: Hanoi Architectural University and Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology

detail.title: ACO-TGFuse: Ant Colony Optimization-Guided Transformer Fusion for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
detail.abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) aims to produce a composite image that combines the thermal saliency of infrared with the structural richness of visible light. Existing deep learning methods rely on manually designed fusion architectures in which the selection of encoder scales for cross-modal interaction is largely unexplored. We propose ACO-TGFuse, a framework that integrates Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) as a one-time offline architecture search over all six pairwise combinations of a four-level multi-scale encoder, identifying the most complementary scale pair without any inference overhead. The search converges to the (en0, en3) pair, bridging fine-grained texture features with coarse-level thermal structure. A Cross-modal Relation Map derived by sequential Channel and Spatial Transformers is broadcast to four encoder scales, yielding Relation-guided Multi-scale Fusion Masks 𝑀0–𝑀3. A Cross-Branch Attention module further refines interaction between the two ACO-selected branches, and dual-discriminator adversarial training sharpens visual fidelity. Evaluated on TNO, RoadScene, and MSRS, ACO-TGFuse achieves the highest SSIMv and 𝑄𝑎𝑏𝑓 scores on all three datasets, with competitive performance across eight standard metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出ACO-TGFuse框架，利用蚁群算法自动搜索多尺度编码器的最优尺度组合（en0, en3），结合跨模态关系图、多尺度融合掩码、跨分支注意力和双判别器对抗训练，实现红外与可见光图像的高质量融合。
AI.research_question: 如何在红外与可见光图像融合中自动选择最优的编码器尺度组合进行跨模态交互？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法依赖人工设计的融合架构，编码器尺度选择对跨模态交互的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蚁群优化（ACO）用于架构搜索；通道-空间变换器生成跨模态关系图；多尺度融合掩码；跨分支注意力机制；双判别器生成对抗网络。
AI.method: 1）用ACO对四层多尺度编码器的六种尺度对进行一次性离线搜索；2）通过通道和空间变换器生成跨模态关系图广播至四个编码层；3）生成关系引导的多尺度融合掩码M0-M3；4）跨分支注意力模块精炼ACO选择的两个分支的交互；5）双判别器对抗训练提升视觉保真度。
AI.findings: ACO搜索收敛到(en0, en3)组合，桥接了细粒度纹理特征与粗粒度热结构；在TNO、RoadScene、MSRS三个数据集上，SSIMv和Qabf指标均达到最高，八项标准指标上表现具有竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将蚁群优化引入IVIF的架构搜索，证明ACO可有效识别最优多尺度编码器组合；提出跨模态关系图广播机制，实现全局-局部跨模态交互。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一种无需推理开销的离线架构搜索方法，可直接应用于现有的多尺度融合框架；在多个公开数据集上取得最优融合质量，具有实际应用价值。

title: UEReID: A Difficulty-Controlled Virtual Dataset and a Spatial Wave-Interwoven Graph Neural Network for Object Re-Identification
affiliations: Shandong University of Science and Technology, Qilu University of Technology, Qilu University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shandong University of Science and Technology and Shandong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: UEReID: A Difficulty-Controlled Virtual Dataset and a Spatial Wave-Interwoven Graph Neural Network for Object Re-Identification
detail.abstract: Object re-identification (ReID) remains challenging for generic aerial targets such as UAVs because viewpoint distortion, scale variation, and cluttered backgrounds weaken identity cues. Existing models rely on category-specific partitions or heavy pre-trained backbones, reducing transferability to objects without stable human- or vehicle-like structures. To address this, we propose S-WIM-GNN, a Spatial Wave-Interwoven Multi-Granularity Graph Neural Network that extracts coarse-to-fine RGB features with a triple-stream backbone, embeds them along learnable sinusoidal paths, and enables geometry-aware message passing through a Spatial Handshake GNN at path intersections. This gated interaction integrates local details with global structure. An Adaptive Feature Refinement module and multi-objective loss further enhance discriminability. We introduce UEReID, a UE4-based benchmark with 70 identities and 13,862 images, graded by a hybrid color-texture similarity metric for controllable appearance difficulty. Experiments on UEReID achieve 86.98% mAP and 93.43% Rank-1, exceeding the baseline by 5.53% mAP while maintaining competitive parameters and edge-device speed. Tests on Market-1501 and CUHK03 show 2.7% average mAP gains, indicating transferable spatial modeling for lightweight aerial ReID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S-WIM-GNN网络，通过多粒度特征提取、可学习正弦路径嵌入和空间交互图神经网络，解决空中目标重识别中的视角畸变、尺度变化和背景杂波问题，并在自建UEReID基准及公开数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖类别特定先验或重型预训练骨干的情况下，实现通用空中目标（如无人机）的鲁棒重识别？
AI.motivation: 现有ReID方法依赖类别特定分区或重型预训练骨干，对缺乏稳定人体/车辆结构的空中目标迁移性差；视角畸变、尺度变化和背景杂波进一步削弱了身份线索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多粒度特征提取、可学习正弦路径嵌入、空间交互图神经网络（Spatial Handshake GNN）、自适应特征精炼、多目标损失。
AI.method: S-WIM-GNN：1）三分支骨干网络提取由粗到细的RGB特征；2）沿可学习正弦路径嵌入特征；3）在路径交叉点通过Spatial Handshake GNN实现几何感知消息传递，融合局部细节与全局结构；4）自适应特征精炼模块加多目标损失增强判别力；5）构建UEReID基准（70身份，13862图像），采用混合颜色-纹理相似度指标控制外观难度。
AI.findings: UEReID上mAP 86.98%、Rank-1 93.43%，超基线5.53% mAP；参数与边缘设备速度保持竞争力；Market-1501和CUHK03上平均mAP提升2.7%，证明空间建模对轻量级空中ReID的迁移有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出几何感知的图神经网络框架，将多粒度特征与空间交互结合；2）可学习正弦路径嵌入实现连续空间建模；3）Spatial Handshake GNN的门控交互机制有效融合局部与全局信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）首个面向通用空中目标ReID的基准UEReID，含可控难度评估体系；2）轻量级模型在边缘设备上保持高效推理，适用于无人机等实际部署场景；3）在行人/车辆数据集上验证了方法的跨类别迁移性。

title: The Temporal Dynamics of Digital Engagement: A Sequential Panel Analysis of Institutional Prerequisites for E-Participation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Temporal Dynamics of Digital Engagement: A Sequential Panel Analysis of Institutional Prerequisites for E-Participation
detail.abstract: This study challenges the dominant techno-centric paradigms of e-government by investigating the institutional prerequisites for digital civic engagement. Using a panel dataset of 149 countries and robust Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) models with one- and two-year temporal lags (t-1, t-2), we propose and empirically test a four-stage ”Institutional Chain” of digital participation. Our findings reveal a sequential maturation of state capacity: Rule of Law (RL) enhances Control of Corruption (CC), together with Regulatory Quality (RQ), drives Government Effectiveness (GE), ultimately fostering Voice and Accountability (VA). Crucially, the final model demonstrates a definitive path dependency: while administrative capacities and economic wealth (ln(GDP_pc)) build foundational structures, only VA directly and significantly drives the E-Participation Index (EPI) as the ultimate sequential stage. In the presence of democratic openness, the direct impacts of GE, CC, and technological infrastructure (TII) on e-participation become statistically insignificant due to full mediation through the causal sequence. Furthermore, temporal robustness checks uncover that raw ICT infrastructure (TII) negatively impacts institutional quality and democratic voice in the absence of the temporal precedence of robust safeguards. We conclude that technological infrastructure and administrative efficiency are necessary but fundamentally insufficient for digital participation; authentic e-participation is an inherently political act that cannot bypass the necessity of sequential democratic institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个"制度链条"框架，发现数字公民参与（E-Participation Index）不能绕过民主制度顺序：法治→反腐→监管质量→政府效能→话语权与问责制，最终只有话语权与问责制直接驱动电子参与，而技术基础设施和行政效率在民主开放存在时完全被中介。
AI.research_question: 数字公民参与（电子政务参与）需要怎样的制度前提条件？技术中心主义范式是否忽视了制度序列的重要性？
AI.motivation: 挑战当前电子政务研究中主导的技术中心主义（techno-centric）范式，强调制度质量（institutional prerequisites）对于数字公民参与的根本性作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四阶段"制度链条"（Institutional Chain）：法治（Rule of Law）→ 腐败控制（Control of Corruption）→ 监管质量（Regulatory Quality）→ 政府效能（Government Effectiveness）→ 话语权与问责制（Voice and Accountability）→ 电子参与指数（E-Participation Index）
AI.method: 149个国家面板数据，双向固定效应（TWFE）模型，1年和2年时间滞后期（t-1, t-2）
AI.findings: （1）制度链条存在顺序成熟路径：法治增强腐败控制，与监管质量共同驱动政府效能，最终促进话语权与问责制；（2）只有话语权与问责制直接显著驱动电子参与（EPI），其他变量被完全中介；（3）在民主开放存在时，政府效能、腐败控制、技术基础设施的影响变得不显著；（4）技术基础设施在缺乏制度保障的时间优先性时，会对制度质量和民主话语产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字参与的"制度序列依赖"（path dependency）机制，证明电子参与本质上是政治行为而非技术行为，丰富了制度理论与电子政务的交汇研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：仅仅投资技术基础设施和提升行政效率不足以推动数字公民参与，必须优先建立法治、反腐、监管和民主问责等制度基础。

title: Parental preferences for an integrated school-work customized bus service considering household heterogeneity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Southwest Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Delft University of Technology and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Department of City and Regional Planning

detail.title: Parental preferences for an integrated school-work customized bus service considering household heterogeneity
detail.abstract: Coordinating children’s school travel with parents’ commuting is a critical challenge in household activity-chain organization and public transport service design in high-density cities. Based on questionnaire survey data from parent commuters in Beijing, this study employs a binary Logit model and a panel mixed Logit model to examine parents’ choice mechanisms regarding integrated school-work customized bus (ISW-CB) services and preference heterogeneity across household groups. The results show that parents value school-end safe access and egress and service reliability. When vehicles are allowed to enter the school campus, the odds of choosing ISW-CB services are about eight times those under the scenario where vehicles are not allowed to enter the campus. Parents are willing to pay approximately 3.7 yuan and 4.0 yuan to reduce one minute of waiting time and school-end walking time, respectively. Household heterogeneity further shapes preferences: households with young children and multiple school-age children emphasize demand-responsive scheduling and service reliability, while car-owning households pay more attention to waiting time. Policy recommendations are proposed regarding school-end safe access and egress, reliable weekday operation, differentiated route planning, fare and subsidy mechanisms, and multi-actor coordination.

AI.tldr: 基于北京通勤家长问卷数据，采用二元Logit和面板混合Logit模型，研究家长对学旅与通勤一体化定制公交（ISW-CB）的选择机制及家庭异质性。发现家长重视校园端安全步行与可靠性，车辆可入校时选择几率约提升8倍，愿为减少1分钟等待和步行分别支付3.7元和4.0元。有幼龄及多学龄儿童家庭更关注灵活调度与可靠性，有车家庭更关注等待时间。
AI.research_question: 家长在协调子女学旅与自身通勤时，对一体化定制公交（ISW-CB）服务的选择机制是什么？不同家庭群体的偏好异质性如何？
AI.motivation: 高密度城市中协调子女上学出行与父母通勤是家庭活动链组织和公交服务设计的重大挑战，现有研究缺乏对家长选择ISW-CB服务机理及家庭异质性的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机效用理论（基于Logit模型框架）、家庭活动链理论、偏好异质性理论
AI.method: 基于北京通勤家长问卷调查数据，采用二元Logit模型与面板混合Logit模型进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）家长高度重视校园端安全步行与服务的可靠性；（2）车辆允许进入校园时，选择ISW-CB的几率约为不允许进入时的8倍；（3）家长愿为减少1分钟等待时间支付3.7元，为减少1分钟校园端步行时间支付4.0元；（4）有幼龄儿童和多学龄儿童家庭更关注需求响应式调度与可靠性，有车家庭更关注等待时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了学旅与通勤一体化情境下家长出行决策的偏好结构，识别了不同家庭类型的异质性选择机制，拓展了活动链理论与随机效用理论在学旅-通勤协同场景中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高密度城市设计ISW-CB服务提供了基于实证的政策建议，包括校园端安全步行与通达设计、可靠的平日运营、差异化路线规划、票价与补贴机制以及多主体协同。

title: Dynamic Time Zone Segmentation Based on Pareto-Optimized Agglomerative Clustering for Personalized Spatiotemporal Group Presence Prediction
affiliations: Jeju National University, Jeju National University, Jeju National University, Jeju National University and Jeju National University

detail.title: Dynamic Time Zone Segmentation Based on Pareto-Optimized Agglomerative Clustering for Personalized Spatiotemporal Group Presence Prediction
detail.abstract: Accurate presence prediction in multi-level parking facilities remains challenging due to the strong spatial and temporal heterogeneity of occupancy patterns. Existing approaches often model the entire day as a single temporal pattern or apply the same fixed temporal partition to all spatial groups, which may fail to capture group-specific temporal behaviors. This paper proposes a Dynamic Time Zone Segmentation method that automatically identifies individual spatiotemporal group structures and improves presence interval prediction by adapting the number of time zones to each spatial group's occupancy behavior. The proposed approach applies Agglomerative Clustering to generate candidate temporal segmentations. Silhouette Score and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) are then jointly evaluated using Pareto Optimization to identify the optimal segmentation size by balancing clustering quality and model complexity. The resulting time zones are subsequently incorporated into the presence prediction process. Experimental results obtained using a real-world dataset from a multi-level parking facility show that the proposed dynamic time zone segmentation method outperforms both fixed segmentation and non-segmentation approaches, reducing the average MSE by 15.3% and 69%, respectively, while improving the average R2 score by 1.6% and 19.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态时区分割方法，通过自适应识别各空间分组的独特时间模式，显著提升了多层停车场的车位占用预测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自适应时间分割来捕捉多层停车场中不同空间分组的独特时间模式，从而提高车位占用预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么将全天视为单一时间模式，要么对所有空间分组使用相同的时间分区，无法捕捉不同空间分组特有的时间行为，导致预测精度受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态时区分割；凝聚聚类；轮廓系数；贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）；帕累托优化
AI.method: 使用凝聚聚类生成候选时间分割，结合轮廓系数和BIC进行帕累托优化，为每个空间分组自适应确定最优时区数量，并将分割结果融入车位占用预测过程。
AI.findings: 动态时区分割方法在真实多层停车场数据集上，相比固定分割和非分割方法，平均MSE分别降低15.3%和69%，平均R²分别提升1.6%和19.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种自适应识别各空间分组独特时间模式的方法，突破了传统固定时间分区的局限，丰富了时空异质性建模的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多层停车场管理提供了更精准的车位占用预测方法，有助于优化停车引导、资源调度和运营效率。

title: The Euro Effect on Current Account Balances
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Lingnan (University) College, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Euro Effect on Current Account Balances
detail.abstract: Does international currency status allow countries to finance larger current account deficits? Euro-area accession provides a useful setting for answering this question because it represents a discrete, staggered, and institutionally governed shift into a major international currency area. We compare 16 euro adopters with 47 nonadopting economies over 1994-2009 in a difference-in-differences design with country and year fixed effects and controls for standard current-account determinants. The estimates indicate an economically meaningful weakening of external balances after euro adoption, with the current account falling by about 4.3 percentage points of GDP in the baseline specification. Event-study and robustness exercises support a post-adoption decline rather than differential pre-trends or sensitivity to sample and estimator choices. Further analysis links this decline to a financing channel. The effect is not confined to peripheral members, which suggests that it is not simply a crisis-periphery episode. It weakens after the European sovereign debt crisis, when sovereign-risk repricing and financial fragmentation reduced the financing value of euro membership. Saving-investment decompositions point mainly to lower national saving, consistent with euro adoption easing external financing and supporting domestic absorption before the crisis.

AI.tldr: 采用欧元使成员国经常账户恶化约4.3个百分点GDP，主要原因是欧元国际货币地位便利了外部融资，降低了国民储蓄。
AI.research_question: 国际货币地位是否允许国家维持更大的经常账户赤字？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少从因果识别的角度检验国际货币地位如何影响一国的外部融资能力，欧元区加入提供了准自然实验的契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际货币地位→外部融资约束放松→经常账户赤字扩大（通过降低储蓄渠道）
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID），比较16个欧元采纳国与47个非采纳经济体（1994-2009），控制国家和年份固定效应及标准经常账户决定因素。
AI.findings: （1）欧元采纳后经常账户下降约4.3% GDP；（2）该效应并非仅存在于边缘国家；（3）欧债危机后效应减弱；（4）储蓄-投资分解表明主要源于国民储蓄下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用准自然实验因果识别国际货币地位对外部平衡的影响，区分了融资渠道而非简单的贸易渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：国际货币地位虽然便利融资，但也可能导致外部失衡累积，需警惕后续危机风险。

title: Physically Informed Neural Network based Fitting of Spectroscopy using Collocation Points for Improved Pathological Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Université de Poitiers

detail.title: Physically Informed Neural Network based Fitting of Spectroscopy using Collocation Points for Improved Pathological Classification
detail.abstract: Proton Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS 1H) at ultra-high field (7T) enables improved metabolic characterization of brain tissues but remains limited by challenges in spectral fitting accuracy and quantification reliability. In this study, we aimed to enhance metabolite quantification using Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) and to evaluate the impact of improved quantification on classification model performance. We developed a new PINN-based spectral fitting framework, named PINN-COLLOC, incorporating collocation points to locally constrain the learning process in complex spectral regions. The proposed method was evaluated against LCModel, the current clinical reference and our previous PINN implementation (PINN-IG). Results demonstrated significant improvements in spectral fitting accuracy for several metabolites, particularly low-concentration or highly overlapping resonances such as lactate, glutamine, lipids and phosphocholine + glycerophosphocholine. Ablation studies confirmed the importance of physical constraints and collocation points in improving model robustness. Beyond spectral fitting, we assessed the impact of metabolite quantification on artificial intelligence classification tasks. A classification model trained using metabolite concentrations derived from PINN-based quantification showed improved diagnostic performance compared to LCModel-based quantification, highlighting the potential clinical relevance of improved spectral fitting. Importantly, our PINN models remove dependency on conventional basis sets, reducing limitations related to their completeness and standardization. However, current implementations still rely on post-processing steps and external parameter extraction tools. Future work will focus on developing a fully standardized framework (PINN-FID) operating directly on time-domain free induction decay signals to eliminate post-processing variability and improve reproducibility across clinical centers. The code is available at https://github.com/lbonnin1/MRS-PINN-COLLOC

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的磁共振波谱拟合框架PINN-COLLOC，通过引入配置点局部约束，显著提升了超高频7T下脑组织代谢物定量精度，并证明了改进的定量结果能提高AI分类模型的诊断性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用物理信息神经网络（PINN）提升超高场（7T）质子磁共振波谱（MRS 1H）的代谢物定量精度，并评估其对AI分类模型性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 超高场7T MRS能更精细地表征脑组织代谢物，但频谱拟合精度和定量可靠性存在瓶颈，限制了其临床应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）、谱拟合、配置点局部约束、LCModel传统方法、AI分类模型。
AI.method: 开发PINN-COLLOC框架，在复杂光谱区域引入配置点进行局部约束；与LCModel及先前PINN-IG方法对比；进行消融实验；将定量结果输入AI分类模型评估诊断性能。
AI.findings: PINN-COLLOC在乳酸、谷氨酰胺、脂质等低浓度或高度重叠代谢物的拟合精度上显著优于LCModel和PINN-IG；消融实验验证了物理约束和配置点的必要性；基于PINN定量的分类模型诊断性能优于LCModel定量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出PINN-COLLOC方法，将配置点机制引入PINN以解决复杂谱区局部约束问题；消除了对传统基组的依赖，降低了基组完整性和标准化带来的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提升临床MRS代谢物定量可靠性，进而提高AI辅助诊断准确率；开源代码促进可复现性；为未来开发全标准化端到端框架（PINN-FID）奠定基础。

title: Preference Heterogeneity versus Economic Incentives:What Determines Long-Term Care Arrangements in Europe?
affiliations: McGill University, University of Chicago and Universidad Carlos III de Madrid

detail.title: Preference Heterogeneity versus Economic Incentives:What Determines Long-Term Care Arrangements in Europe?
detail.abstract: Care arrangements vary widely across families and countries. To understand why, wedevelop a tractable static bargaining model of family long-term-care choices and estimateit using European data. Families choose among child-provided informal care,including which child becomes the caregiver, formal home care, mixed care, and nursing-homecare, taking into account both monetary costs and heterogeneous non-monetarypreferences over care arrangements. Preference heterogeneity strongly dampens policyresponsiveness: without it, a 20% subsidy to nursing-home and formal-home-care costsraises the use of formal care by 7.5%, compared with only 4.0% in the baseline model.Cross-country differences in care arrangements are shaped more by non-monetary factorsthan by formal-care prices. Looking ahead, the model predicts a substantial increasein demand for formal care by 2050, driven by a declining ratio of adult children toelderly parents, with the largest increases in countries where informal care is currentlypredominant.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个家庭长期照护选择的静态议价模型，利用欧洲数据估计发现：非货币偏好异质性显著削弱政策效果；跨国照护模式差异主要受非货币因素而非价格影响；到2050年，成年子女与老年父母比例下降将大幅推高正式照护需求，尤其在当前以非正式照护为主的国家。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同家庭和国家的照护安排存在巨大差异？家庭如何在子女非正式照护、正式居家照护、混合照护和养老院照护之间做出选择？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭照护选择背后的驱动因素，特别是非货币偏好如何影响政策效果，以及人口结构变化对未来照护需求的冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静态家庭议价模型，纳入货币成本与非货币偏好异质性（包括子女和父母双方偏好）。
AI.method: 基于欧洲数据的结构估计，通过模型反事实模拟检验政策效果和人口结构变化的影响。
AI.findings: ①偏好异质性显著抑制政策响应（无偏好异质性时补贴使正式照护使用率提高7.5%，有异质性时仅4.0%）；②跨国照护差异主要由非货币因素驱动；③到2050年，子女-父母比例下降将大幅增加正式照护需求，最显著的是当前非正式照护主导的国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非货币偏好异质性正式纳入家庭照护选择的议价模型，揭示了偏好异质性对政策有效性的阻尼效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于照护补贴政策效果的重要启示：忽略偏好异质性会高估政策效果；为提前应对人口老龄化带来的正式照护需求激增提供了预测依据。

title: Executive Compensation and Conflicts of Interest in Analyst Research
affiliations: University of Oklahoma, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Oklahoma - Division of Finance

detail.title: Executive Compensation and Conflicts of Interest in Analyst Research
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether executive compensation incentives can affect how sell-side analysts produce and disseminate accounting information about other firms. We examine brokerage houses whose executives receive relative performance evaluation (RPE) awards based on total shareholder returns. By linking executive pay to named peers’ stock prices, these contracts create incentives for affiliated analysts to disclose unfavorable information about those peers when it is most relevant for the broker’s compensation outcome. We find that affiliated analysts devote more attention to RPE rivals, and their research becomes more negative during final performance-measurement windows: they revise earnings forecasts downward, write in a more pessimistic tone, and elicit more negative announcement returns. Forecast accuracy does not decline, consistent with strategic dissemination of credible negative information. The effects concentrate among peers whose stock price declines can improve the broker’s relative rank, and final rankings cluster on the payout-favorable side of rank cutoffs. Overall, the results show that executive incentives can create conflicts of interest in the production, timing, content, and tone of analyst research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，券商的高管薪酬激励（基于相对绩效评估的RPE奖励）会促使关联分析师在绩效评估窗口期内，有策略地发布关于RPE对标公司的负面信息，以提升自家券商的相对排名和薪酬回报。
AI.research_question: 高管薪酬激励（RPE奖励）如何影响卖方分析师生产和传播关于其他公司（RPE对标公司）的会计信息？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注高管薪酬对管理者自身决策的影响，但较少探讨高管薪酬激励如何通过组织内部传导，影响下属分析师的信息生产和传播行为，尤其是涉及其他公司（RPE对标公司）的信息披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对绩效评估（RPE）理论、代理人激励理论、分析师利益冲突理论
AI.method: 实证研究，使用券商RPE奖励数据、分析师盈余预测、研报语气分析、事件研究法（公告日市场反应）以及排名断点附近分布检验。
AI.findings: (1) 关联分析师在绩效评估窗口期内更关注RPE对标公司；(2) 下调盈利预测，研报语气更悲观；(3) 公告日引发更负面的市场反应；(4) 预测准确性未下降，说明是策略性传播可信的负面信息；(5) 效应集中于那些股价下跌能改善券商相对排名的对标公司；(6) 最终排名聚类在有利于薪酬支付的断点一侧。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高管薪酬激励通过组织内部传导，创造分析师利益冲突的新机制；将RPE激励的影响从管理者自身决策扩展到信息中介（分析师）的信息生产行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者识别分析师研究中的利益冲突提供了新的视角；提醒企业在设计高管薪酬方案时需考虑其对下属信息生产行为的潜在扭曲效应。

title: The Impact of Health Expenditures on Welfare in OECD Countries: Does COVID-19 Matter?
affiliations: University of Mazandaran (UMZ), University of Mazandaran, University of Mazandaran and Università di Parma

detail.title: The Impact of Health Expenditures on Welfare in OECD Countries: Does COVID-19 Matter?
detail.abstract: Background :The impact of health expenditure on national welfare and development has become a critical area of research, particularly following the COVID-19 pandemic.Objective :This study examines the impact of total and government health expenditures on Legatum prosperity and the Human Development Index (HDI) in OECD countries, with a specific focus on analyzing the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on these indicators.Methods :Two models and scenarios were analyzed using data from 2007 to 2023 for OECD countries. In the first model, the Legatum prosperity index was used as the dependent variable, while in the second model, the Human Development Index (HDI) served as the dependent variable. The first scenario investigated the impact of total health expenditure and its interaction with COVID-19, whereas the second scenario focused on government health expenditure and its interaction with COVID-19.Results :The results indicate that both total health expenditures (coefficient of 0.708 on welfare and 0.238 on human development) and government health expenditures (coefficient of 0.586 on welfare and 0.156 on human development), along with their interaction with COVID-19, have a statistically significant positive impact on both welfare and human development index.Conclusions :Strong evidence supports the effectiveness of healthcare expenditures, particularly public health spending and its interaction with the COVID-19 pandemic, in enhancing welfare and human development index.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2007-2023年OECD国家的数据，发现总卫生支出和政府卫生支出及其与新冠疫情的交互作用，对国民福利（Legatum繁荣指数）和人类发展指数（HDI）均有显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 卫生支出（总支出和政府支出）对OECD国家的繁荣指数和人类发展指数有何影响？新冠疫情如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情后，卫生支出对国家福利与发展的影响成为关键研究领域，但现有文献对其在不同指标（福利与HDI）上的差异化影响，以及疫情作为调节因素的实证分析尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卫生经济学理论、人力资本理论、公共财政理论——探讨卫生支出如何通过改善健康人力资本进而促进国家福利与人类发展。
AI.method: 使用2007-2023年OECD国家面板数据，构建两个回归模型：（1）以Legatum繁荣指数为因变量；（2）以人类发展指数（HDI）为因变量。每个模型下设两个情景：总卫生支出及其与COVID交互项、政府卫生支出及其与COVID交互项。
AI.findings: 总卫生支出对福利的系数为0.708、对HDI为0.238；政府卫生支出对福利的系数为0.586、对HDI为0.156。两者及其与新冠疫情的交互项均呈统计显著的正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了卫生支出（尤其是公共卫生支出）对福利和人类发展的积极效应，并将新冠疫情作为情境因素纳入分析框架，丰富了卫生经济学与人类发展理论的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为OECD国家及类似经济体提供了政策依据：增加卫生支出（特别是政府公共卫生投入）能有效提升国民福利和人类发展水平，在疫情等公共健康危机时期这一效应更为显著。

title: Transforming Health Systems: Mapping the Landscape with 172 Regional Cross-sector Partnerships in the Netherlands
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Transforming Health Systems: Mapping the Landscape with 172 Regional Cross-sector Partnerships in the Netherlands
detail.abstract: Background: Regional collaborative approaches have become an important feature of health system transformation across the globe, including the Netherlands. While national policies increasingly rely on such partnerships to advance integrated, population-oriented approaches, empirical insight into how cross-sector partnerships (CSPs) are configured at scale within specific policy contexts remains limited. Objective: This study aims to map the national landscape of CSPs in the Netherlands by identifying distinct partnership configurations and examining how these relate to determinants for sustainable health and wellbeing system development. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted using data from two rounds (2023–2024) of a national survey of CSPs (n = 172). Structural and strategic characteristics were analyzed descriptively and used in a latent class analysis to identify distinct CSP configurations, which were subsequently compared across determinants for sustainable health and wellbeing system development. Results: Two configurations were identified: (1) broadly oriented CSPs, characterized by larger scale, wider population scope, and broader prevention focus; and (2) smaller, targeted CSPs focusing on specific populations or care pathways. Differences mainly reflect variation in strategic orientation and associated coordination demands, including alignment with policy agendas and the coordination of multiple networks and organizations. Despite these differences, both configurations showed similar patterns across key determinants, with relatively strong relational capacities (e.g., trust, leadership, shared commitment), but weaker development of accountability structures, financial arrangements, and data availability. Conclusions: The findings indicate that Dutch CSPs develop through distinct, strategically varied configurations, but nonetheless face broadly similar developmental challenges within their shared policy context.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于荷兰全国172个跨部门合作组织的调查数据，通过潜在类别分析识别出两种合作配置模式：广泛导向型（规模大、覆盖广）和精准靶向型（聚焦特定人群/路径）。两者在信任、领导力等关系能力上较强，但在问责机制、财务安排和数据可用性方面均面临类似挑战。
AI.research_question: 在荷兰特定政策背景下，跨部门合作伙伴关系如何在全国范围内形成不同的配置模式，以及这些模式与可持续健康与福祉系统发展的决定因素之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管区域协作已成为全球卫生系统转型的重要特征，荷兰国家政策也日益依赖此类伙伴关系推进整合性、人群导向的健康服务，但关于跨部门合作伙伴关系如何在具体政策背景下规模化配置的实证研究仍十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨部门合作配置理论、可持续健康与福祉系统发展决定因素框架
AI.method: 横截面研究，基于2023-2024年两轮全国性调查数据（n=172），对结构性和战略性特征进行描述性分析，并采用潜在类别分析识别不同的合作配置模式，随后比较这些模式在可持续健康与福祉系统发展决定因素上的差异。
AI.findings: 识别出两种配置模式：（1）广泛导向型——规模更大、人口覆盖更广、预防重点更宽泛；（2）精准靶向型——聚焦特定人群或护理路径的小型合作。两者在关系能力（信任、领导力、共同承诺）上较强，但在问责结构、财务安排和数据可用性方面均较薄弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在全国层面系统描绘荷兰跨部门合作组织的配置格局，揭示了在相同政策背景下合作组织如何通过战略性差异化形成不同模式，拓展了跨部门合作配置理论在卫生系统领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了荷兰跨部门合作的全景图像，指出无论合作模式如何，都需在问责机制、财务安排和数据共享等基础设施方面加强建设，为健康系统转型中的合作治理提供实证依据。

title: Health Costs of Electricity Reliability Failures: Evidence from a Large-Scale Blackout in Brazil
affiliations: Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP, Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP and Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP

detail.title: Health Costs of Electricity Reliability Failures: Evidence from a Large-Scale Blackout in Brazil
detail.abstract: Electricity reliability is a health input. We study the November 2020 Amapá blackout, a 22-day transmission failure in an isolated Brazilian grid. Using monthly public hospital admissions for 5,572 municipalities and a two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences design, we estimate that admissions in Amapá rose by 14.8 percent after the blackout (p = 0.023), and by 23.4 per cent when excluding the window most exposed to Brazil’s second COVID-19 wave. A synthetic-control exercise with electricity-consumption records inde pendently validates treatment intensity: consumption fell 12.7 percent below the synthetic counterfactual in November 2020. The response is concentrated in electricity-dependent channels: infectious admissions more than doubled; diabetes and circulatory admissions increased; elective admissions fell during the outage and later rebounded; urgent admissions rose persistently; and ICU spending more than doubled. Birth records also indicate changes in delivery conditions and neonatal health. The evidence implies that grid redundancy, hospital backup power, and medical cold-chain resilience should be evaluated as health-system investments as well as infrastructure investments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2020年11月巴西阿马帕州持续22天的输电故障这一自然实验，采用双重差分和合成控制法，发现停电导致公立医院入院率上升14.8%，尤其是传染病、糖尿病和心血管疾病入院显著增加，ICU支出翻倍，并影响新生儿健康。研究表明电网冗余和医院备用电源应被视为健康基础设施投资。
AI.research_question: 大规模长期停电如何影响人口健康（以医院入院率为衡量指标）？
AI.motivation: 电力可靠性是健康的重要投入要素，但缺乏因果证据。巴西阿马帕州2020年11月发生22天输电故障，提供了一个罕见的外生冲击来识别停电对健康的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力可靠性作为健康投入的理论框架，将停电视为影响医疗服务可及性、医疗设备运行、药品冷链保存以及传染病防控机制的外生冲击。
AI.method: 双重差分（DID）和合成控制法。利用巴西5572个城市的月度公立医院入院数据，以未受停电影响的地区为对照组。
AI.findings: 停电使阿马帕州入院率上升14.8%（p=0.023）；排除受第二波新冠影响最严重时期后上升23.4%；电力消耗较合成反事实下降12.7%；传染病入院翻倍；糖尿病和心血管疾病入院增加；择期入院在停电期间下降后反弹；急诊入院持续上升；ICU支出翻倍；分娩条件和新生儿健康出现变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"电力可靠性是健康投入"提供了严谨的因果估计，区分了停电对不同类别健康影响的异质性机制（直接医疗需求 vs. 替代性医疗服务）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示电网冗余、医院备用电源和医疗冷链韧性不仅应作为基础设施投资评估，还应作为卫生系统投资评估，为发展中国家电力基础设施与公共卫生体系的交叉规划提供政策依据。

title: Democratizing quantitative data use for risk assessments: An open source, web-based tool for public health emergency preparedness

detail.title: Democratizing quantitative data use for risk assessments: An open source, web-based tool for public health emergency preparedness
detail.abstract: Public health agencies across the United States are required to conduct risk assessments, yet this is burdensome without adding clear value. This study examines limitations of current practices, including the lack of an accessible, quality tool, lack of personnel experience and training, lack of public health-specific inputs, and failure to link to mitigation strategies. Additionally, current risk assessments are based on historical data, resulting in inaccurate projections of risk given the increasing frequency and severity of hazards due to climate change.Researchers conducted a survey and semi-structured interviews that illuminate practitioners’ experiences with risk assessments. Researchers addressed a gap in resources by developing an open source, scalable tool that automates data collection and analysis. The tool produces public health-focused risk assessments drawing on near real time data and incorporating climate trends. The automated tool allows for instant updates to jurisdictional risk assessments at no cost.Researchers’ use of an AI coding assistant to build a custom Python application demonstrates how emerging technology can increase access to quality tools that reduce burden on public health agencies. It provides a common operating picture across agencies and jurisdictions. The tool further increases the utility of risk assessments by linking to actionable preparedness strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对美国公共卫生机构风险评估存在的负担重、价值低问题，开发了一款基于近实时数据和气候趋势的开源自动化风险评估工具，并通过AI编码助手构建，有效提升了评估效率和实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决当前美国公共卫生机构风险评估中工具缺乏、人员培训不足、依赖历史数据导致预测不准确等问题，开发一款可扩展、低成本且实用的自动化风险评估工具？
AI.motivation: 美国公共卫生机构必须进行风险评估，但现有实践负担沉重且价值不明确；同时气候变化导致灾害频率和强度增加，基于历史数据的评估结果不准确，亟需更高效、更精准的评估工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化与风险动态评估理论；公共卫生风险评估方法论；自动化工具设计与开源技术应用。
AI.method: 研究者通过问卷调查和半结构化访谈了解从业者实践痛点；随后利用AI编码助手开发了一款基于Python的开源自动化工具，整合近实时数据与气候趋势。
AI.findings: 该自动化工具能即时更新风险评估结果且零成本；提供跨机构、跨辖区的通用操作视图；将风险评估与可操作的备灾策略相链接，显著提升了评估的实用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候趋势纳入公共卫生风险评估框架，弥补了传统历史数据方法的不足；展示了AI辅助开发在公共卫生工具建设中的应用路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一款免费、开源、可扩展的自动化风险评估工具，降低公共卫生机构负担；实现了评估结果的实时更新与跨机构协同；链接具体备灾策略，增强了评估的可操作性。

title: Mind the gap.  Perceptual Mismatches in Membership Barriers in Spanish Agroecological Cooperative Supermarkets

detail.title: Mind the gap.  Perceptual Mismatches in Membership Barriers in Spanish Agroecological Cooperative Supermarkets
detail.abstract: Membership growth and strategic recruitment are key challenges for co-operative organizations seeking to expand their social impact. Agroecological Cooperative Supermarkets (ACSs), often framed as spaces of social innovation and sustainable consumption, depend on aligning internal perceptions with external realities to remain organizationally resilient. This study surveyed 1,156 respondents across the 17 nodes of the Spanish ACS Network, including both members and non-members, to compare members’ assumptions about non-participation with non-members’ self-reported barriers and to assess age differences in member motivations. Members overestimated all barriers relative to non-members’ reports, especially price and lack of interest in conscious consumption, while practical barriers such as lack of awareness, distance, and time were more salient for non-members. Contrary to expectations, cultural and identity-related barriers were not stronger predictors of joining intention than functional barriers. Younger members placed greater emphasis than older members on political, transformative, price, and proximity-related motivations. These findings suggest that recruitment strategies focused on justifying price are likely misdirected, whereas awareness-building, logistical accessibility, and generation-sensitive messaging appear more promising for expanding cooperative food models.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了西班牙 agroecological 合作超市网络中成员与非成员之间的认知差异，发现成员高估了非成员参与障碍（尤其是价格和缺乏兴趣），而实际障碍（如缺乏意识、距离、时间）对非成员更为关键。年轻成员更注重政治、变革、价格和邻近性等动机。建议合作超市应将招募策略从价格辩护转向提高认知、改善物流可及性和代际差异化宣传。
AI.research_question: 合作超市组织成员对非参与障碍的感知与非成员自我报告的实际障碍之间是否存在差异？不同年龄层成员加入合作社的动机有何不同？
AI.motivation: 合作超市（ACSs）作为社会创新和可持续消费的空间，依赖于内部认知与外部现实的匹配来保持组织韧性。然而，成员容易高估外部障碍，导致招募策略方向错误，限制合作社的社会影响力扩展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会创新理论、可持续消费理论、组织韧性理论、代际动机差异理论
AI.method: 对西班牙 agroecological 合作超市网络17个节点的1,156名受访者（包括成员和非成员）进行问卷调查，比较成员对非参与障碍的假设与非成员自我报告障碍，并评估成员动机的年龄差异。
AI.findings: （1）成员高估了所有障碍，尤其是价格和缺乏有意识消费兴趣；（2）非成员更关注实际障碍：缺乏意识、距离和时间；（3）文化/身份障碍对加入意愿的预测力并不比功能障碍更强；（4）年轻成员比年长成员更看重政治、变革、价格和邻近性动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了合作组织中"认知偏差"（成员高估外部障碍）对招募策略的误导性影响，挑战了价格是主要障碍的传统假设，并引入代际动机差异视角丰富合作组织成员招募理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作超市提供优化招募策略的实证依据：应减少对价格辩护的投入，转向提高公众意识、改善物流便利性和制定代际差异化沟通方案。

title: Evaluating and improving decision-making: A scoping review of individual cognition in child protection services
affiliations: University of Stavanger, University of Stavanger and University of Stavanger

detail.title: Evaluating and improving decision-making: A scoping review of individual cognition in child protection services
detail.abstract: Decision-making in child protection services is complex and uncertain with high stakes. In recent decades, cognitive psychology has increasingly informed discussions of professional judgement, yet its conceptualisation within child protection services remains unclear. This scoping review examines how cognitive decision-making is conceptualised and studied in research on individual decision-making within child protection services. A systematic search and synthesis of 143 articles were conducted, with explicit attention to theoretical perspective and intended contribution. A thematic analysis of the included articles shows different theoretical perspectives. Some focus on the internal cognitive processes, with a marked emphasis on intuitive versus analytical reasoning, while others focus on the external factors that influence these internal processes. The review also identifies three main goals the articles pursue. They either try to identify and describe cognitive processes, evaluate and improve decision-making or examine the influence of contextual and attitudinal factors. Across studies, explicit theoretical grounding is often limited, contributing to substantial terminological variation and conceptual ambiguity. Overall, the field presents a substantial but uneven knowledge base: theoretically clustered yet terminologically fragmented, and often focused on identifying vulnerabilities in intuitive judgement, with another strand framing intuition as a form of expertise gained through experience. Greater theoretical transparency and conceptual precision are needed to advance understanding of professional judgement in child protection and to inform empirically grounded improvements in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了143篇关于儿童保护服务中个体决策的研究，发现该领域在理论上聚类但术语碎片化，认知决策的概念化存在明显模糊性，研究目标分为识别描述认知过程、评估改进决策、考察情境因素三类，且理论支撑普遍不足。
AI.research_question: 在儿童保护服务研究中，认知决策是如何被概念化并加以研究的？
AI.motivation: 儿童保护服务中的决策具有高度复杂性和不确定性，尽管认知心理学越来越多地被用于讨论专业判断，但其中认知决策的概念化仍不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学视角下的决策理论，包括直觉与分析推理、内外部认知过程理论。
AI.method: 系统性范围综述，对143篇文章进行系统检索、综合归纳和主题分析，关注理论视角和研究意图。
AI.findings: 1. 存在两种主要理论视角：聚焦内部认知过程（直觉vs分析推理）与聚焦外部影响因素；2. 研究目标分为三类：识别描述认知过程、评估改进决策、考察情境与态度因素；3. 理论支撑普遍有限，导致术语多样化和概念模糊；4. 知识基础虽庞大但不均衡：理论上聚类但术语上碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了儿童保护服务决策领域在认知概念化上的理论聚类与术语碎片化的矛盾，指出直觉判断的两种对立理解（脆弱性vs.经验型专长），呼吁理论透明度和概念精确性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童保护服务的实践改进提供基于实证依据的方向，强调需要更清晰的理论指导以提升专业判断质量。
